data.raw_text:
🚨The Day Italy Chose to Clean Its Hands A Lesson for the Philippines 🇵🇭

📣When corruption infects every corner of government, when senators, congressmen, and contractors all dip their hands in public funds, reform becomes impossible from the inside.

👉🏽🚩That’s exactly what happened in Italy during the “Mani Pulite” (Clean Hands) investigation in the 1990s. Nearly the entire political system was exposed, from mayors to ministers. Ghost projects, fake contracts, and kickbacks were the norm. Sounds familiar, doesn’t it?

🚩But instead of surrendering, Italians demanded accountability. Independent prosecutors launched nationwide investigations. Thousands of officials resigned. Entire parties collapsed. It was painful, chaotic, yet it became the turning point that forced Italy to rebuild its political system from the ashes.

👉🏽The Philippines needs that same fire.
No more closed-door executive sessions. No more recycling of the same names, same faces, same schemes.

✊🏽Because without true accountability, everything we dream of, progress, justice, national pride,  will stay just that: a dream.

✊🏽Maybe it’s time for our own version of “Clean Hands.”
A reckoning not to destroy the nation, but to finally cleanse it. 🕊️
